svg.text: Makeshift Flipper · bare stack · single 118×46 mm plate, top (component) view
46×18 holes, 2.54 mm pitch · USB-C on the left, antenna on the right · hole (x, y): x = 1–46 left→right, y = 1–18 top→bottom
Dashed = hangs below the plate. Hole labels: IO number, signal name; filled colour = net.
ESP32-C6 DevKit (USB-C ← → antenna): 2 × 16 female header, rows 8 holes apart
2 × 20 male pins, pin 1 on the left, rows 7 holes apart
flying leads, no holes under it
flying leads, no holes under it
dashed: 125 kHz coil 46×33, read face down
dashed: RDM6300 board, inside the coil
dashed: bridge feet (4 tall under RC522, 4 short under battery)
Top strip holes (y 1–3): RDM6300 wires x27–29 (TX, GND, 5V) + 1k/1k/1k divider; RC522 wires x27–34 (CS SCK MOSI MISO IRQ GND RST 3V3).
Red ring with X = never wire (IO12/IO13, TX/RX: USB / console). Orange dashed ring = strapping pin: do not pull low at reset.
Resistors/diodes are drawn between their two holes; the body covers the holes in between, so nothing else goes there.
Positions of the dashed items come from bare_stack.html (mm); hole positions of everything else come from make_plan_bare.py.
